cross-instance-round-1.json.cause: CookieJar contains an RLock and cannot be deepcopied. Test harness stopped before cross-instance assertions.
cross-instance-round-1.json.resolution: Copy individual cookies into a new CookieJar.

cross-instance-round-2.json.cause: Test harness attempted an invalid empty-permission custom role. API correctly rejected it.
cross-instance-round-2.json.resolution: Replace stock.read with valid product.read, then verify stock.read is revoked.

database-readback-round-1.json.cause: Historical verifier assumed refund always uses the 600-cent SKU. The real detail page default selected the 400-cent SKU. Order was correctly refunded for 400.
database-readback-round-1.json.resolution: Verify each order against its pre-transaction fixture SKU and price, and check both SKU balances.
